revision_basis.reason: Compatibility provenance retained for the original fail-closed phase-1 implementation.

revision_history.diagnosis: The generic manual reverse-D8 bridge in revision 0.5 is rejected. The frozen geometry was originally created by the project-standard Pysheds catchment call from the containing-cell center coordinate. Morphometry must replay that exact frozen geometry-generation pour-point semantics rather than infer an alternative outlet-cell topology.

frozen_geometry_input.source: exact GitHub Actions geometry artifacts referenced by the outlet-freeze registry
frozen_geometry_input.verification: SHA256 of each downloaded GeoJSON must exactly equal geometry_geojson_sha256 in the frozen registry

exact_geometry_dem_reconstruction.hard_integrity_gate: regenerated DEM GeoTIFF SHA256 must exactly equal geometry_freeze.dem_utm_sha256 for every target before morphometry is accepted
exact_geometry_dem_reconstruction.fallback: none; any hash mismatch fails closed

exact_geometry_pourpoint_replay.coordinate_rule: map the unchanged frozen accepted outlet coordinate to the containing exact-DEM cell using rasterio; use that cell center x/y as the coordinate passed to Pysheds, exactly as in the frozen geometry delineator
exact_geometry_pourpoint_replay.pysheds_internal_cell_audit: record grid.nearest_cell(cell_center_x,cell_center_y) and its center distance to the unchanged frozen accepted outlet; require <= one 30 m cell diagonal
exact_geometry_pourpoint_replay.canonical_mask_rule: the replayed Pysheds catchment is routing provenance only; the frozen polygon cell-center mask remains the metric inclusion mask
exact_geometry_pourpoint_replay.alignment_gate: Jaccard(replayed Pysheds catchment, frozen-polygon cell-center mask) >= 0.995 and at least 99.5 percent of frozen-polygon center cells belong to the replayed catchment
exact_geometry_pourpoint_replay.failure: fail closed; do not move the outlet, alter geometry, widen masks, or tune a tolerance from morphometry values

main_channel_distance.method: Pysheds distance_to_outlet replayed from the exact same cell-center coordinate used for frozen geometry generation
main_channel_distance.weights: Pysheds cell_distances(fdir,dirmap) on the exact projected 30 m DEM, so orthogonal and diagonal D8 cell-center link lengths are measured in metres
main_channel_distance.selection: maximum finite weighted distance among cells selected by the unchanged frozen-polygon center mask that also belong to the replayed canonical catchment

unchanged_metric_semantics.polygon_area_and_perimeter: exact frozen polygon projected to EPSG:32718
unchanged_metric_semantics.drainage_density: unchanged threshold and link rule; only qualifying links whose upstream and downstream cells are both inside the frozen-polygon cell-center mask count

forbidden: read A6680 numeric morphometry before phase-1 output hash is frozen
use metric values observed in failed phase-1 runs to tune a method
move an outlet or alter/expand a frozen basin polygon
change DEM conditioning, slope algorithm, D8 method, channel threshold or cell-inclusion rule to improve agreement
accept a regenerated DEM whose GeoTIFF SHA256 differs from the frozen geometry-generation DEM hash
substitute a manual reverse-D8 topology for the exact Pysheds geometry-generation semantics
include replay-only catchment cells in polygon, elevation, slope or drainage-density masks
discard a target because of unexpected morphometry
